# Naejimer 3D Planet Generator

- Asset ID: `naejimer.godot_3d_planet_generator`
- Godot Asset Library: https://godotengine.org/asset-library/asset/1615

- Original archive SHA-256: `21be38c25cc8aa9ff2f1259d67962ed2bc8ca4942318206347fee1d606f66be9`

Only the upstream body, cloud, and atmosphere shaders plus the MIT license
are retained. The project demo, scenes, noise presets, icon, and project
configuration are intentionally excluded. Files under `processed/` are
adapted for an opaque, depth-tested Space Syndicate presentation component.
